messages:
sara_marketing: Quick ask for launch/webinar prep — marketing needs a reproducible micro-benchmark + sanity checklist we can hand to legal and the webinar team. Need by TOMORROW 9am PT. Items: 1) 20 representative payloads (short/medium/long/edge) + a CSV mapping to intent, 2) explicit cold-start vs warmed p95/p99, 3) quantized vs FP delta with exact model hash + quant recipe, 4) exact single-line command for Dedicated and Hosted that we can paste into docs, 5) short note on variability (CI or repeated runs). This will be linked in the webinar demo notes. @tom_runtime @rachel_eng :pray:

 tom_runtime: We can produce that. Couple clarifying q's: which model/tag for the headline numbers (v2-7b or v2-13b)? Do you want streaming metrics included or strictly non-stream token timing? Also, do you want us to include a cold-start heatmap (first N requests) or just median cold vs warmed numbers?

 sara_marketing: Headline is v2-7b. For the webinar, the UX uses streaming but the press numbers should be non-stream token timing. Include both cold-start heatmap (first 20 requests) and warmed steady-state (after 200 warmup tokens).

 rachel_eng: For the pack: we'll tag each payload with "edge" boolean and include a sanitized long example for demo. Sampling: keep deterministic (temp=0) for numbers. For the repeated runs, suggest 5 independent trials with fresh process start to capture cold variance.

 amit_metrics: I'll compute bootstrap CI for p95/p99 across the 5 trials and attach a tiny CSV (percentile, mean, lower_ci, upper_ci). That will help legal.

 tom_runtime: Working plan: create microbench/1998765000/{payloads.json,manifest.csv,run_dedicated.sh,run_hosted.sh,report.csv,readme.md}. We'll record exact docker image and commit hash. Example run command we'll include for Dedicated (exact snippet you can paste):

 ```bash
 ./run_dedicated.sh --model redwood-v2-7b --quant q4 --seq 512 --batch 1 --warmup 200 --repeats 5 --out out/1998765000
 ```

 tom_runtime: Hosted example (uses API key env var):

 ```bash
 REDWOOD_API_KEY=... ./run_hosted.sh --model redwood-v2-7b --quant q4 --payloads payloads.json --seq 512 --batch 1 --warmup 200 --repeats 5
 ```

 rachel_eng: We'll also add a tiny python snippet showing how to parse tokens and compute token-per-second. Something like: `tokens = [resp.token_count for resp in responses]` and compute percentiles.

 sara_marketing: Perfect. Legal will need the provenance line exactly as: "run_by: <name>, run_ts: <UTC ISO>, model_tag: <tag>, commit: <git-sha>, quant_recipe: <name>" — please put that in README.md.

 tom_runtime: Noted. We'll put provenance in README.md and a one-line summary for copy: e.g. "Quantized (q4) p95 latency increased X% vs FP; throughput improved Y%" — we'll fill exact numbers.

 amit_metrics: One more request: can runtime include raw per-request latencies (anonymized) so I can compute CI? We won't publish per-user data, just timing.

 tom_runtime: Yes we'll include per-request latencies in report.csv (no payload contents).

 upload-bot: artifact uploaded: gs://redwood-bench/microrepro/1998765000/microbench-pack.tar.gz (payloads.json, manifest.csv, run_dedicated.sh, run_hosted.sh, report.csv, readme.md)

 sara_marketing: Thank you! We'll review first thing and flag if any numbers look off. Can you also add an inline note in README about any non-deterministic factors (GPU warm caches, cloud noise) so we can set expectations in the webinar?

 rachel_eng: Good call. We'll add a short bullet list: "Sources of variance: OS scheduling, GPU clock state, host load, quantization randomness (seed)." We'll recommend the canonical way to re-run (exact docker image + seed).

 tom_runtime: Final note: we sanitized one long prompt to remove third-party text. Manifest flags which payloads are synthetic. If marketing wants different mix, tell us and we can swap quickly.

 sara_marketing: Looks great. Thanks everyone — this helps the press deck + webinar script a lot. We'll ping if legal needs more detail. :rocket:
